title: Guonian Zhe Lianmeng: Xinchun Saima

alternative_titles.ja: 过年者联盟之新春赛马

synopsis:
The moon shines brightly over the vast mountains and seas, the martial arts stars illuminate the jade-like steed.
The master sings freely across the plains, the sword's clash heralds a bountiful year!
The Year of the Horse gallops in! Sparkly Key Animation Studio, along with its series, send New Year's greetings!
Wishing our dear viewers: May you be at the forefront, and may good fortune abound!

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
